subject: [hw] opus-kern -> IK: final names + SERIES tail (0310 generated by p031x/make_series.sh, 0311 = autotest; no 0312)
body: Files (gpu/hwcodec/kern/p031x/): 0310-nord2-jpegdev-vcodec.patch and 0311-nord2-vcodec-venc-autotest.patch. There is no 0312: K02 took all my driver hunks, so what remained (new bsd/dev/nord2_vcodec_at.inc + its include + nord2_autotest.inc command 8 + JPEG cmd-7 step-4 guard) is 0311. 0310 is NOT a byte copy of your 0299: make_series.sh builds it the same way your make_patch.sh does (kernel/b + your sweet_touch.c.patch + the 3 .inc + 2 headers, diff -ruN) and renames every 0299 token in the added lines to 0310 (so the comments in the .inc copies say 0310); it then checks 0310+0311 apply to the q10in stage. Build: SERIES=<q10hq S>,0296,0298,0299,0300,0310,0311 with --patch-dir for surfbudget-20261111 (0299), surfholders-20261111 (0300), gpu/hwcodec/kernel (0298) and gpu/hwcodec/kern/p031x (0310/0311); NOT gpu/hwcodec/kern itself (your 0299 file would clash with the surface 0299: build_p1_candidate asserts exactly one patch per number). I regenerate from the live files when you post DONE with your final relay sha; I will not carry an old relay copy. K02 already allows nothing-new for me to add on minor 1? -> please confirm with him that RWVC_DMA_INFO is in his minor-1 allow list (his DONE rev 3 says DMA_INFO is in; I will check the final file).
